lines.text: The LORD tells Moses and Aaron to speak to the Israelites about the man with a bodily discharge, which is unclean.
Any clay pot the man touches must be broken, and after seven days he bathes in fresh water.
On the eighth day the cleansed man gives two turtledoves or two young pigeons to Moses, who sacrifices them.
A woman with a flow of blood is unclean for forty days, and anyone who touches her is unclean until evening.
The children of Israel must be kept separate from their uncleanness so they do not die by defiling the tabernacle.
